    <dd>when restoring, Tier can be specified as the supported recovery model.
There are three recovery models for recovering archived storage type data, which are:</p>
<ul>
<li>Expedited: quick retrieval mode, and the recovery task can be completed in 1-5 minutes.</li>
<li>Standard: standard retrieval mode. Recovery task is completed within 3-5 hours.</li>
<li>Bulk: batch retrieval mode, and the recovery task is completed within 5-12 hours.
For deep recovery archive storage type data, there are two recovery models, which are:</li>
<li>Standard: standard retrieval mode, recovery time is 12-24 hours.</li>
<li>Bulk: batch retrieval mode, recovery time is 24-48 hours.</li>
</ul></dd></dl>
